name: Lindern (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lindern (Oldenburg) (a green linden tree with a shield on white).
history: Municipal flag of Lindern; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lindern arms — linden tree with shield on white
